name: Universal Music Group N.V.
blurb: Universal Music Group N.V. is a global music company operating through Recorded Music, Music Publishing, and Merchandising & Other segments. It discovers and develops recording artists, licenses and distributes music, and engages in live events and sponsorship. As one of the world's largest music companies, it holds a dominant market position with a vast catalog of artists and songs.
recent: In early April 2026, Pershing Square Capital Management proposed to acquire UMG in a cash-and-stock deal valuing the company at €30.4 per share, a 78% premium over the prior close. The proposal sent UMG stock soaring nearly 11% and would merge UMG with Pershing Square SPARC Holdings for a NYSE listing. The stock has since traded around €19.15, reflecting ongoing market reaction.
